page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2ne.4xlarge is a storage- and memory-focused virtual machine instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It runs on an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz, offering 8 physical cores and 16 dedicated vCPUs with hyperthreading enabled. The configuration includes 128 GB of RAM, yielding an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio. Attached directly to the instance is 3839 GB of local SSD storage, alongside a baseline network bandwidth profile of 5 Gbps. The architecture integrates AVX-512 instruction extensions and 33 MB of shared L3 cache, with no hardware GPU acceleration provisioned.

Benchmark outcomes show distinct multi-threaded throughput contrasted against constrained single-thread capacity. The instance posted an average multi-core score of 5855.0 in Geekbench and 11742.55 in stress-ng multi-core, whereas single-core tests rated in the bottom quartile, including a Geekbench single-core score of 946.0 and single-threaded gzip compression at 19.02 GB/sec. Memory subsystem testing shows large-block uncached read speeds of 66.14 GB/sec and write speeds of 58.29 GB/sec. Operational benchmarks demonstrate reliable performance under concurrent loads, achieving 11.7 million operations per second in Redis SET tests and 4310.67 in PassMark database operations.

Resource allocation presents a deliberate tradeoff: single-core compute performance is moderate, reflecting the older CPU generation, but resource density in local fast NVMe SSD storage and memory capacity remains significant. This architecture provides high operational utility for I/O-intensive workloads where direct local disk access and expansive memory buffers matter more than raw per-thread clock cycles. The ecs.i2ne.4xlarge is suited for operational databases, distributed transactional caching layers, analytical data stores, and backend indexers.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2ne.4xlarge is a storage- and memory-focused KVM instance designed for I/O-heavy enterprise workloads. It is equipped with 16 dedicated vCPUs across 8 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz, supported by 128 GB of RAM and 3839 GB of integrated local SSD storage. Network capacity provides a 5 Gbps baseline, and the server features AVX-512 support without hardware GPUs. Benchmarks exhibit solid concurrent processing, demonstrated by 11.7 million Redis SET operations per second and average multi-core scores in Geekbench and PassMark, although single-threaded execution trails modern compute-focused platforms. With an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio and substantial local high-speed disk space, the ecs.i2ne.4xlarge fits transactional databases, caching layers, and search indexers.
